        l = 0.3245,
        nslit = 9,

        h2 = 0.020,
        l = 1.985,

        mright = 1,
        mtop = 1,
        mbottom = 1,
        wavy = 0

        h1 = 0.020,
        w2 = 0.030,
        h2 = 0.020,

        h1 = 0.020,
        w2 = 0.030,
        h2 = 0.020,

        xmax = 0.030,
        ymin = -0.030,
        ymax = 0.030

    Slit aperture1 (
        xwidth = A1w,
        yheight = A1h
    ) AT (0, 0, 8.000) RELATIVE guide_in;

    // Wavelength monitor 3
    L_monitor lmonitor2 (
        nL = 140,
        filename = "lmonitor2.dat",
        xmin = -0.0155,
        xmax = 0.0155,
        ymin = -0.0105,
        ymax = 0.0105,
        Lmin = 0.0,
        Lmax = 17.0
    ) AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.651) RELATIVE aperture1;

    // Slit S6
    Slit S6_slit (
        radius = S6
    ) AT (0, 0, 2.800) RELATIVE aperture1;

    // Aperture 2
    Slit APERTURE2 (
        radius = A2
    ) AT (0, 0, L1) RELATIVE aperture1;

    // Wavelength monitor 4
    L_monitor lmon2 (
        nL = 140,
        filename = "lmonitor3.dat",
        xmin = -0.0075,
        xmax = 0.0075,
        ymin = -0.0075,
        ymax = 0.0075,
        Lmin = 0.0,
        Lmax = 17.0
    ) AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.285) RELATIVE APERTURE2;

    // PSD monitor 4
    PSD_monitor psd4 (
        nx = 100,
        ny = 100,
        filename = "psd4.dat",
        xmin = -0.0075,
        xmax = 0.0075,
        ymin = -0.0075,
        ymax = 0.0075
    ) AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.286) RELATIVE APERTURE2;

    // Final component
    Arm final_arm AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE;

    // Define beam path
    isis_source
        -> lmon1
        -> psd1
        -> bender1
        -> bender2
        -> bender3
        -> bender4
        -> bender5
        -> bender6
        -> bender7
        -> bender8
        -> bender9
        -> bender10
        -> lmonb
        -> psd2
        -> guide_in
        -> guide_straight1
        -> guide_straight2
        -> guide_straight3
        -> guide_straight4
        -> psd3
        -> aperture1
        -> lmonitor2
        -> S6_slit
        -> APERTURE2
        -> lmon2
        -> psd4
        -> final_arm;

    // Set simulation parameters
    set_seed(123456789); // Fixed seed for reproducibility
    set_ncount(1e6); // Moderate number of neutrons for testing
    set_gravity(true); // Gravity is important for cold neutrons
}
